description: Unit test cases for the TalkPromptBuilder in the OpenClawKit project, testing prompt construction including transcript content and interruption/hint options.

classes.name: TalkPromptBuilderTests
classes.description: Test suite for the TalkPromptBuilder class.

methods.name: testBuildIncludesTranscript
methods.description: Verifies that the prompt built includes the transcript and the phrase indicating talk mode is active.

methods.name: testBuildIncludesInterruptionLineWhenProvided
methods.description: Checks that the prompt includes an interruption line when interruptedAtSeconds parameter is provided.

methods.name: testBuildIncludesVoiceDirectiveHintByDefault
methods.description: Ensures the prompt includes a voice directive hint by default.

methods.name: testBuildExcludesVoiceDirectiveHintWhenDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that disabling includeVoiceDirectiveHint prevents the hint from appearing in the prompt.
